build_PyrenderRenderer: build a PyrenderRenderer instance with a topology OBJ file path and custom rendering dimensions
create_checkerboard_geometry: create a checkerboard floor geometry with configurable tile size, colors, and up-axis orientation
render_meshes_forward: render a batch of 3D mesh vertex tensors into RGBA images using the forward method
